stem: How have major parties reacted to the scenario described above?

options.label: A
options.text: By suing the third parties in court for campaign-finance violations

options.label: B
options.text: By persuading the third parties to present a new platform

options.label: C
options.text: By addressing the issues raised by the third parties

options.label: D
options.text: By preventing third parties from holding conventions

visual_elements: Discontent with major political parties leads to the organization of a third party.
Potential voters mobilize support for the third party.
The third party becomes competition for the major parties.
